A Roman copper alloy contemporary copy of a dupondius of Claudius (AD 41-54), CERES AVGVSTA S C reverse type depicting Ceres seated left holding corn-ears and long torch. Uncertain mint. RIC I (revised edition), pp. 127 & 129, cf. nos. 94 & 110; Boon, 'Counterfeit Coins in Roman Britain', pl. III, no. 38. Obverse: Long necked, bareheaded bust, left. Obverse inscription: []. Reverse: Ceres seated left holding corn-ears and long torch. Reverse inscription: CER[ES AVGVSTA S C]. Dimensions: diameter: 26.58mm; weight: 7.57g.
